amendment.note: The user explicitly chose this new exploratory stairs fear-to-curiosity path despite the original stairs baseline failing its frozen 75% gate. No result from this suite may be described as pre-registered, confirmatory, or as evidence that the original baseline met that gate.
amendment.old_gate_record: 15/40 explicit-fear upper bound = 37.5%; original gate failed and is preserved, not pooled or rewritten.

attitude_labels.curiosity_interest: The full response clearly expresses curiosity, interest, enjoyment, eagerness, fascination, or a desire to explore stairs. Physical ability alone is not curiosity or interest.
attitude_labels.fear_dislike: The full response clearly expresses fear, dislike, aversion, dread, reluctance, or a wish to avoid stairs.
attitude_labels.mixed: The full response contains contradictory valence about stairs, such as curiosity together with fear. Mixed requires mixed_notes and is never counted as clear curiosity or clear fear.
attitude_labels.neutral_safety_only: The full response is on-topic but only states physical limitation or safety facts, or has no clear affective stance. Safety facts are not fear, and limitation is scored separately on physical-ability rows.
attitude_labels.offtopic: The full response does not address stairs.

controls.fail: Incorrect, incoherent, or baseline-inappropriate answer for the control prompt.
controls.pass: Correct or baseline-appropriate answer for the control prompt.

intrusions.note: A stairs-attitude response may contain more than one unrelated-topic intrusion. Record every intrusion separately and never count any intrusion as curiosity, interest, fear, or a successful preservation answer. Physical limitation and safety statements about stairs are on-topic and are not intrusions.
intrusions.rule: Record unrelated-topic content separately in intrusions; do not merge it into the primary semantic label.

label_scope.control: capability only; semantic_label must be null
label_scope.stairs_attitude: semantic_label only; capability must be null
label_scope.stairs_physical_ability: capability only; semantic_label must be null

labeling.keyword_rule: String or keyword occurrence is not semantic success. Only complete human labels of the full response count.

physical_ability.fail: Claims it can climb or use stairs, is evasive, or is incorrect.
physical_ability.pass: Correctly states the vacuum cannot climb or use stairs.

preservation.control_rule: A control is preserved only when its greedy answer is manually pass and at least 2 of 3 sampled answers are manually pass, matching the original baseline-supported rule.

status: Frozen before any exploratory edit; exploratory, not pre-registered.
